subject.title: 🐛 Feishu channel fails with tenant_access_token error when HTTP proxy is configured

question: Should Feishu SDK HTTP and WS bootstrap traffic follow OpenClaw ambient/managed proxy routing as implemented in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86386, or wait for a broader per-channel proxy policy?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but it decides how app credentials, tenant tokens, and channel traffic cross operator proxy boundaries; automation should not choose that security/product contract.

options.title: Approve PR 86386 Policy
options.body: Accept Feishu SDK HTTP following ambient and managed proxy routing, land the focused PR, and keep broader direct/proxy controls on separate issues.

options.title: Require Per-Channel Policy First
options.body: Pause the PR until maintainers define an explicit Feishu proxyMode or direct/ambient contract across SDK HTTP, guarded fetches, and WebSocket behavior.

options.title: Docs-Only Mitigation For Now
options.body: Leave runtime behavior unchanged and publish NO_PROXY/mixed-proxy guidance while collecting more live Feishu proxy evidence.

recommendation.title: Approve PR 86386 Policy
recommendation.body: Accept Feishu SDK HTTP following ambient and managed proxy routing, land the focused PR, and keep broader direct/proxy controls on separate issues.

likelyOwner.reason: Shared proxy-helper history and security-boundary context make this the best available owner for deciding the egress contract.
